verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Auto Drafts give every email that needs a reply a draft "written in your voice." They also say Superhuman AI matches the voice and tone of the user's sent emails, adapts style per recipient, and accepts plain-language writing instructions. Drafts are presented for the user to review, edit and send. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the voice matching actually avoids generic boilerplate.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate

citations.quote: Best of all, the email sounds like you. Superhuman AI matches the voice and tone in the emails you've already sent
Every message that needs a reply comes with a draft written in your voice.
Every draft matches your voice and tone, using your unique style for each person. You can review the drafts in Superhuman Mail, or edit and send directly from your AI assistant.
with Auto Drafts 2.0, every message that needs a reply comes with a draft. You can just edit and send.
Add plain-language instructions like "write in lowercase" or "use this booking link" to personalize your writing and scheduling features.
